This exploits any myopic repeat-bidding while avoiding overpaying in medium supply.

Cindy massively overbids and is harmless if supply is decent; David is dead, Bob likely gone, Eric is the main competitor with moderate bids. I conserve on high-supply days, bid just above Eric/yesterday pressure on tight days, and spike only when HP/no-water risk is high.

Cindy likely overbids every day and burns out; Eric is cheap/passive at 15; Bob is erratic and already fragile; David bids 0. I exploit this by bidding near Eric+ to secure water cheaply, only escalating when supply is tight or my HP/no-water risk is high.
